cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can take my ladder once you've put aside the first sausage for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you lend it as a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Put the favour down as lunch owed; I'll collect when the barbecue starts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can give you lunch, but I need you to hold the ladder too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make it two sausages. You climb, I'll hold, and bring my plate over before you start serving everyone else.
